finding.title: The `fgets` function reads up to `sizeof(buffer) - 1` characters into `buffer`, but if the line is longer than 255 characters, it will be truncated.

scan_orig.message: Check when opening files - can an attacker redirect it (via symlinks), force the opening of special file type (e.g., device files), move things around to create a race condition, control its ancestors
Statically-sized arrays can be improperly restricted, leading to potential overflows or other issues (CWE-119!/CWE-120).
